description: Start a speed test on an owned proxy. It uses real traffic and usually finishes later: read the result with get_speed_test. Rate limited; respect retry_after_seconds. Only Coronium Node rentals support this; other proxies answer 404.

confirm.description: True only after the user explicitly authorized this disruptive action.

proxy.description: Owned modem _id (24 hex characters), exact name or portId from get_proxies.
